prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic 9:16 vertical triptych / three-panel photo collage with casual Gen-Z selfie aesthetic, slight lo-fi grain, intimate bedroom lighting and authentic candid energy.
prompt.main_subject: One clearly adult woman with warm light-medium olive/tan skin, subtle natural grain and faint freckles across the nose bridge, shoulder-length dark espresso-to-soft-black layered wavy hair with wispy curtain bangs, deep brown almond-shaped heavy-lidded eyes, dark defined upper lashes, and dusty-rose pink lips. She wears a pale pastel-pink ribbed camisole with delicate floral lace trim along the neckline and straps. Keep her identity original and non-celebrity; do not reproduce Jenna Ortega.
prompt.composition_elements: Arrange three equal vertical panels in a 9:16 collage. Top panel: the adult woman runs a hand through her hair while leaning slightly forward, winking tightly with the right eye, left eye toward camera and making a closed-lip playful smirk. Middle panel: shoulders squared and centered with direct soft gaze, gentle suppressed smile and a pink heart-crown filter of floating cartoon hearts above the head. Bottom panel: left index finger presses playfully into the left cheek. Set all panels in the same dim bedroom with a large bed, messy white-and-cream duvet, white pillow, textured beige throw pillow, beige tufted headboard, taupe-gray walls, white closet-door frame and silver handle.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm tungsten lamp light from the left casts soft shadows to the right. Preserve intimate bedroom ambience, cute romantic mood, natural skin texture, realistic fabric detail and slight lo-fi grain without over-polishing.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 9:16 vertical triptych, consistent identity and wardrobe across panels, casual smartphone selfie aesthetic, slight lo-fi grain, natural anatomy and hands, clean collage alignment, no text, logo or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 9:16 vertical three-panel selfie collage of one original clearly adult woman with warm light-medium olive skin, faint freckles, shoulder-length dark espresso wavy hair, wispy curtain bangs, deep brown almond eyes, defined lashes and dusty-rose lips, wearing a pale pastel-pink ribbed camisole with floral lace trim. Top panel: hand through hair, slight forward lean, right eye tightly winking, playful closed-lip smirk. Middle panel: shoulders squared, direct soft gaze, gentle smile, floating pink cartoon-heart crown filter above head. Bottom panel: left index finger pressing into left cheek. Same dim bedroom in every panel: messy white-and-cream bed, pillows, beige tufted headboard, taupe-gray walls, closet door and silver handle. Warm left tungsten lamp, soft rightward shadows, intimate cute romantic candid Gen-Z mood, slight lo-fi grain, no public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish styling, minor, teenage appearance, public-figure likeness, Jenna Ortega likeness, inconsistent face, inconsistent outfit, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, broken collage alignment, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, random text, logo, watermark
